verdict.rationale: stagewise is a standalone desktop IDE for macOS, Windows and Linux. It has a dedicated Diff Review page with a side-by-side diff view and inline accept/reject/undo, and its docs say it runs multiple agent instances in parallel, each with its own chat session and model. missing for 10: explicit documentation that parallel sessions are shown side by side in the UI, independent or hands-on corroboration of the diff review and multi-session features.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review diffs visually and run multiple sessions side by side in a desktop app

citations.quote: stagewise is a standalone desktop IDE where AI coding agents can read, write, and modify files across your workspaces.
For changes across multiple files, open the dedicated Diff Review page. It provides: A scrollable list of every modified file, Side-by-side diff view
Accept, reject, or undo every agent edit with full inline diffs
stagewise supports multiple agent instances running in parallel. Each agent has its own chat session and can use a different model.
Download the stagewise agentic IDE for macOS (Apple Silicon & Intel), Windows (64-bit), or Linux.
